mutations.label: the per-provider split is removed and every operation is filed under one cloud — the throwaway script's own first bug, which printed "scaleway: 370 served" and looked like a measurement
an operation no pack serves is counted instead of refused, so a stale record renders a table missing rows and says so nowhere
a percentage truncates again, so 166 of 173 prints 95 where the record says 96
an axis is counted under a name the record does not publish, so one of the seven silently reads zero everywhere
naming an axis lists nothing, so the output is a score and never a work queue

note: The first mutation is the one #402 asks for by name. It is not a deletion: p.Name() is still called twice, so the harness's own rule (a mutation must not drop an identifier the original used) is satisfied and the package still builds — the failure it produces is a wrong table, which is exactly the failure the issue is about.
